title: Tooltip that works on hover, focus and touch
when: The user wants a short text hint that appears next to an icon button or term on hover and focus.
prompt:
Goal: A tooltip that meets WCAG 1.4.13: shown on hover and focus, hoverable, dismissable with Escape, persistent until left.
Steps:
1. The trigger is focusable, usually <button type="button">; the tip is <div role="tooltip" id="tip-1"> linked by aria-describedby, or aria-labelledby for icon only buttons.
2. Show on pointerenter and focus, hide on pointerleave and blur; Escape hides it even while hovered.
3. Wait about 300 ms to show and 100 ms to hide so the pointer can move onto the tip.
4. Place it above with position: absolute and bottom: 100%; flip below when getBoundingClientRect leaves under 8 px of room.
5. On touch, a tap on the trigger toggles the tip.
Quality bar:
- Plain text under about 80 characters.
- The tip never covers its own trigger.
- A short fade, removed with reduced motion.
Pitfalls:
- Links or buttons inside a tooltip (use a popover).
- The title attribute as the only hint.
- Tips on disabled buttons that cannot take focus.
Verify:
- [ ] role="tooltip" with an id the trigger references.
- [ ] Hover and focus both show it.
- [ ] Escape hides it.
- [ ] It stays on screen near edges.
Output: Trigger and tip markup, tooltip.css and tooltip.js wiring every [data-tooltip] trigger.

examples.input: tooltip nos icones da barra de ferramentas
examples.output: icon buttons with aria-labelledby tips, 300 ms delay, Escape to hide, flips below near the top edge
